conclusion: With only the training target changed (raw official return -> full-timestamp z-score rescaled by one pool constant to the centered-pool variance, raw-label target_std kept), the seed-mean paired daily all-eight-time RankIC difference against the raw-label 10-day/1500 reference was +0.046347 against the unchanged floor of 0.011647; per window research_a: +0.064981, research_b: +0.027713. Seed 11 progress was +0.036584 and is not part of the decision. Error reporting, kept separate from ranking: research_a: raw-label MSE 1.033639e-05, centered-label MSE 8.780151e-06, optimized transformed-target loss 1.259908e-05 (seed 11); research_b: raw-label MSE 1.545138e-05, centered-label MSE 1.122348e-05, optimized transformed-target loss 1.479845e-05 (seed 11). Same-seed contrast against the centered control (report only): RankIC +0.003226 (per window research_a: +0.004271, research_b: +0.002182), gross +0.000023200, turnover -0.038482. The candidate fails the predeclared gates worst_day_guardrail, so the raw-label 10-day reference is retained. The three seeds are complete; this is not evidence that every cross-sectional label transform is uninformative.

progress_seed11.note: Progress display only after all six fits. It cannot accept, reject or stop the experiment.

research_a.interpretation: All three arms use 1500 x 32 = 48,000 sample exposures on the same training dates and seeds; only the training target differs.

research_b.interpretation: All three arms use 1500 x 32 = 48,000 sample exposures on the same training dates and seeds; only the training target differs.

policy.exposure_policy: Steps, batch size, learning rate and recipe stay fixed for this round; a larger pool gets no extra steps because that would confound coverage with compute.
policy.interpretation_rule: A non-accept result bounds what equal-compute date expansion achieves; it does not establish that more history is uninformative.
policy.primary_metric: paired daily all-eight-time RankIC, seed-mean per day before pairing

statistics.sensitivity_rule: Report both block lengths; conflicting conclusions are inconclusive, and neither is chosen after seeing results.

gates.thresholds_status: copied unchanged from the frozen 20261017 v4 calibration

hypothesis: Standardizing the official label within each full training timestamp, then restoring the centered training-pool variance with one constant, makes the target scale comparable across market states and improves out-of-sample ranking against the raw-label 10-day reference under the unchanged gates. Passing that comparison would not by itself show the new standardization beats the centered control.

label_transform.assumption_status: minimal unverified assumption for this project; the public cross-sectional z-score precedent does not establish that variance matching improves this model or beats the centered control
label_transform.cross_section: one complete timestamp of the frozen 10-day training pool, all stocks and all eight sample times; never a random mini-batch
label_transform.evaluation: official raw labels for every ranking, long-short, turnover and raw-label error; centered-label error and the optimized transformed-target loss are named separately
label_transform.fallback: timestamp-centered training-label mean over the selected rows, identical to the centered control; not re-estimated from y*
label_transform.formula: r = float64(float32(y)); z = r - mean_t(r); q = z / std_t(r) if std_t(r) > 0 else 0; c = std(z) / std(q); y* = float32(c q)
label_transform.inference: network(x) * target_scale; c is never multiplied back and no future timestamp mean or standard deviation is added

research_a.c_formula: std(centered training labels, ddof=0) / std(q, ddof=0) over the complete training pool
research_a.fallback_basis: timestamp-centered training-label mean in the same float32 representation used by the centered control; never re-estimated from the transformed targets
research_a.formula: q = (r - mean_t(r)) / std_t(r); y* = c q with c = std(z) / std(q), all ddof=0
research_a.scope: every row of each full training timestamp in the selected training pool; computed once before mini-batches and before the min-history mask

research_b.c_formula: std(centered training labels, ddof=0) / std(q, ddof=0) over the complete training pool
research_b.fallback_basis: timestamp-centered training-label mean in the same float32 representation used by the centered control; never re-estimated from the transformed targets
research_b.formula: q = (r - mean_t(r)) / std_t(r); y* = c q with c = std(z) / std(q), all ddof=0
research_b.scope: every row of each full training timestamp in the selected training pool; computed once before mini-batches and before the min-history mask

label_transform.pool_constant: c is computed once from every selected training row before mini-batches and before the min-history mask

public_precedent.use: Qlib applies CSZScoreNorm per datetime; this round only borrows that public cross-sectional z-score template. Matching the centered pool variance with one constant c is this project's control design, not a copied Qlib configuration.

label_transform.target_scale: raw official training-label standard deviation, unchanged from the reference
label_transform.zero_variance: zero-variance timestamps keep all rows with q=0; the whole-pool std(q)=0 case fails before training

limitations: Two research windows and three seeds are selection data, not independent confirmation.
The CSZ template has a public cross-sectional precedent, but matching the centered pool variance with one constant is this project's control design, not a validated Qlib recipe.
The target_std remains the raw-label standard deviation by design, so the optimized target is y*/target_std rather than the dimensionless q.
Raw-label MSE, centered-label MSE and the optimized transformed-target loss measure different targets; none replaces the official competition score.
The centered-control contrast is descriptive and cannot promote or reject the candidate.
Confirmation, locked and legacy final ranges were not opened; platform time and memory limits remain unverified.
next_steps: If rejected, form a new pre-registration before testing another standardization strength or loss; do not retune this round after seeing its result.
If accepted, freeze the complete candidate and a separate confirmation plan before opening any untouched range; do not overwrite the current reference weights.
only_factor: training target raw official return -> float32(c q), where q is the full-timestamp z-score and c = std(centered labels)/std(q), both ddof=0 over the complete training pool; target_scale stays the raw-label std; network, inputs, steps, batch order, MSE, seeds and dates fixed

recipe_fixed.target_std_fit: raw official selected training labels, full 10-day pool

reference_source.note: The six raw-label fits and the six centered fits are reused, never refitted. Their weights, predictions, training keys, labels and configs are checked before the freeze.

control_comparison.note: Reported only. Passing the raw-label comparison does not show the new standardization beats the centered control, and no post-hoc gate is added to this contrast.

research_a.interpretation: All three arms use 1500 x 32 = 48,000 sample exposures on the same training dates and seeds; only the training target differs.

research_b.interpretation: All three arms use 1500 x 32 = 48,000 sample exposures on the same training dates and seeds; only the training target differs.

decision.interpretation: A non-accept result rejects the claim that this variance-matched timestamp z-score target improves the retained raw-label 10-day reference under the unchanged gates. It does not show that every cross-sectional transform or target scale is uninformative.
decision.limitations: Two research windows and three seeds are selection data; local gross metrics exclude fees and slippage; the centered-control contrast is descriptive only; the platform time and memory limits remain unverified.
decision.note: The formal decision uses candidate minus raw-label reference only. The same-seed centered-control contrast is reported to separate 'beats the raw reference' from 'new standardization beats centering'.
decision.only_factor: training target raw official return -> float32(c q), where q is the full-timestamp z-score and c = std(centered labels)/std(q), both ddof=0 over the complete training pool; target_scale stays the raw-label std; network, inputs, steps, batch order, MSE, seeds and dates fixed

conventions.cross_section: one prediction timestamp; average ranks for ties
conventions.daily: equal timestamp mean; undefined correlations remain missing and are counted
conventions.extreme_return: mean of worst ceil(1% * days) daily long-short returns
conventions.long_short_sharpe: daily mean / sample std * sqrt(periods_per_year); zero variance undefined
conventions.official_score: not implemented: official complete evaluation rules unavailable
conventions.portfolio: equal tail weights; floor(n*quantile), minimum one; boundary ties share weight
conventions.rank_ic_ir: daily mean / sample std (ddof=1), not annualized
conventions.signal_change: mean absolute raw score change and rank correlation on common stocks; first timestamp undefined; consecutive sampled timestamps, including overnight
